tool.name: delete_task
tool.description: Permanently delete a task for the authenticated user. Returns the deleted task's ID, status, and title.

user_id.description: User ID extracted from JWT token (automatically provided by authentication)

task_id.description: Unique identifier of the task to delete
Unique identifier of the deleted task

errors.description: JWT token is missing or invalid
errors.example: Authentication required: Invalid or expired token

errors.description: Task does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated user
errors.example: Task not found: No task with ID aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa
Database error: Unable to delete task

notes: This operation is permanent and cannot be undone
Attempting to delete the same task twice will result in a 'task_not_found' error
User isolation is enforced - users can only delete their own tasks
